configurations.name: 1-Click Launch Unified Engineering Workbench (Packaged)
configurations.comment: Runs the standalone Windows x64 launcher (no editor extension required). On Windows 11, Launch.exe opens src/frontend/index.html in the default browser with no terminal, no build, no admin rights.

configurations.name: Run C++17 Backend & Verification Suite (Linux/WSL)
configurations.comment: Debugs the pre-built Linux ELF backend under GDB (requires Linux or WSL). For Windows source build: cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build

configurations.name: Run C++17 Test Suite (Linux/WSL)
configurations.comment: Runs the 16-test verification suite under GDB on Linux/WSL. Expected output: 16/16 tests PASSED.
